title: Stationarity gives the weak minimal surface system Δu = div G(Du) for graph functions (Simon Ch. 5, §1, 1.1–1.3; Ch. 4, 2.2–2.6; area formula)
statement: Let m ≥ 1 and k ∈ ℕ. There is G : L(ℝ^m, ℝ^k) → L(ℝ^m, ℝ^k), C^∞, with G(0) = 0 and DG(0) = 0, with the following property. Let P ∈ ℕ, U, M ⊆ ℝ^P, y ∈ ℝ^P, let ι : ℝ^m → ℝ^P and ι' : ℝ^k → ℝ^P be linear isometries with ⟨ιa, ι'b⟩ = 0 for all a, b and every z ∈ ℝ^P of the form ιa + ι'b, let s, t > 0 and u : ℝ^m → ℝ^k. Assume: U is open; the cylinder Z := {y + ιa + ι'b : ‖a‖ < s, ‖b‖ < t} is contained in U; u is C¹ on B_s(0) with ‖u(a)‖ < t there; with F(a) := y + ιa + ι'u(a), M ∩ Z = F(B_s(0)) and tangentSpace M (F(a)) = range DF(a) for a ∈ B_s(0); H^m(M ∩ K) < ∞ (H^m = μHE[m]) for every compact K ⊆ U; and M is stationary in U: ∫_M trace(P_x ∘ DX(x)) dH^m(x) = 0 for every C¹ map X : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with compact support and tsupport X ⊆ U, where P_x is the orthogonal projection onto span(tangentSpace M x). Then for every C¹ map ζ : ℝ^m → ℝ^k with compact support and tsupport ζ ⊆ B_s(0): ∫_{B_s(0)} Σ_j ⟨Du(x)e_j, Dζ(x)e_j⟩ dx = ∫_{B_s(0)} Σ_j ⟨G(Du(x))e_j, Dζ(x)e_j⟩ dx (e_j the standard basis of ℝ^m).
lean_statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ), 1 ≤ m → ∃ G : (Euclid m →L[ℝ] Euclid k) → (Euclid m →L[ℝ] Euclid k), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) G ∧ G 0 = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ G 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ (P : ℕ) (U M : Set (Euclid P)) (y : Euclid P) (ι : Euclid m →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid P) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid P) (s t : ℝ) (u : Euclid m → Euclid k), (∀ a b, inner ℝ (ι a) (ι' b) = 0) → (∀ z : Euclid P, ∃ a b, z = ι a + ι' b) → 0 < s → 0 < t → IsOpen U → {z : Euclid P | ∃ a ∈ ball (0 : Euclid m) s, ∃ b ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (k)) t, z = y + ι a + ι' b} ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 s) → (∀ a ∈ ball (0 : Euclid m) s, ‖u a‖ < t) → M ∩ {z : Euclid P | ∃ a ∈ ball (0 : Euclid m) s, ∃ b ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (k)) t, z = y + ι a + ι' b} = (fun a => y + ι a + ι' (u a)) '' ball 0 s → (∀ a ∈ ball (0 : Euclid m) s, tangentSpace M (y + ι a + ι' (u a)) = Set.range (fderiv ℝ (fun a => y + ι a + ι' (u a)) a)) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ U → ∫ x in M, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ X x).toLinearMap) ∂μHE[m] = 0) → (∀ ζ : Euclid m → Euclid k, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid m) s → ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid m) s, ∑ j : Fin m, inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ u x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) (fderiv ℝ ζ x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) = ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid m) s, ∑ j : Fin m, inner ℝ (G (fderiv ℝ u x) (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) (fderiv ℝ ζ x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))))
